raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] For its spell version, see Earthquake Spell . "Causes a powerful earthquake which destroys Walls and damages Buildings " Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History 5 Trivia 5.1 Comparisons Summary The Earthquake Boots is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Barbarian King . It is unlocked when the Blacksmith is completed, requiring Town Hall level 8. The Earthquake Boots appears as a pair of brown boots which have light yellow collars, a brown strap held by a buckle, and golden toe guards with spikes on them. When equipped, it enables the Barbarian King to create an earthquake when using his ability. This earthquake instantly destroys Walls at any level and does significant damage to buildings and defending troops proportional to their maximum hitpoints within a 16-tile diameter, or 8 tiles centered on where the Earthquake Boots was activated. The earthquake caused by Earthquake Boots is able to damage resource storages, unlike conventional Earthquake Spells . The Earthquake Boots' effects are reduced against buildings or troops that have already been hit by one or more Earthquake Spells, with the damage reduction dependent on the number of Earthquake Spells already used and scaled similarly. The reverse is also true: Earthquake Spells will have reduced effects against buildings or troops that have been damaged by the Earthquake Boots. In addition to the ability, the Earthquake Boots also increases the damage per second and maximum hitpoints of the Barbarian King when equipped. Strategies Offensive Strategies The Earthquake Boots can be seen as an alternative to Earthquake Spells , as it is able to destroy any Level of Walls, while 4 Earthquake Spells are required to do the same thing. It also has a much larger radius, being able to affect many more buildings compared to 4 Earthquake Spells. When paired with the Giant Gauntlet , it can destroy entire compartments of key defenses. as it can cripple buildings heavily and the opening of them allows him to charge through them. Sometimes, the ability might allow an early Town Hall weapon activation due to the earthquake, and since it has a larger radius then the Earthquake Spell, many players can activate the weapon early, so be careful. The Earthquake Boots' wall-breaking ability works better on tight bases with lots of compartments than on bases with fewer compartments. However, it should be noted that opening access to a large number of compartments may not always be desirable, and so one's attack plan must factor what the Barbarian King expects to do with this ability. The bonus damage can help tackle small ground Clan Castle troops , but cannot destroy the Skeletons summoned from Skeleton Traps . The troop percentage damage is highly effective against high health ground Clan Castle troops and defending Heroes . This can also weaken strong defenses at lower Town Hall Levels, because the damage taken by buildings is greater than the Earthquake Spells at the lower Levels. At higher Levels, the proportional damage is high enough that pairing with Spiky Ball can destroy some of the buildings, and leaves high hitpoint buildings and defenses heavily damaged. Defensive Strategies Placing separate layers of Walls 9 tiles apart prevents the Earthquake Boots from destroying both layers at once if the Barbarian King is behind both layers. As mentioned above, having fewer compartments in the wall layout reduces the possible value from the ability. Avoid putting powerful defenses and defending Heroes too close to each other, as a good ability might wipe a lot of hitpoint, which means the attacker will get a lot of overall value from this ability, if paired alongside the Spiky Ball or Fireball .
